svg.title: Reproduce the supported M2 gates
svg.desc: Use a fresh destination; the build refuses to overwrite existing work. Authorized SSH access to the exact Hive and DeTTa sources is required. Public HTTPS retrieves the pinned Reachability/PLN inputs. The native build uses pinned PeTTa/SWI, hashed Python dependencies and new Janus objects; DeTTa is compiled into a fresh target. Git/Python/Cargo download caches may be warm. scripts/verify_m2.py runs the preserved M1.2 verifier and then isolated M2 fixtures, eight upstream revision guard tests, native revision, recovery/privacy, native Hive and a deterministic CLI demo. The exact final evidence run used a clean detached d9e7577 checkout and recorded commands/output paths. Failed development runs remain preserved. Building the presentation is a separate operation and never reruns or overwrites these integration records.
svg.text: Run from the evidence revision or a reviewed descendant. See the runbook for Linux and source access.
VERIFY BASELINE, C1, C2, PRIVACY, RECOVERY AND REAL HIVE
Read: manifest.json → final/verification.json → per-suite logs → final/demo.json
Fixture success, native provider success, blocked historical inputs and unrun extensions remain separate.
OMEGA × ASI / THROUGH M2 / runbook.md · build_m2.py · verify_m2.py
